title: G 5058 SCVi SFP Active Dishwasher
sub: Fully integrated, stainless steel front, pocket handle
lead: Miele's fully integrated dishwasher with a stainless steel front and a pocket handle. The controls sit on the top edge of the door, the wash is rated at 44 dB(A), and QuickIntenseWash finishes in under an hour.

features.name: QuickIntenseWash
features.line: A complete wash in under 60 minutes, for the evenings the dishwasher has to turn around quickly.

features.name: Quiet at 44 dB(A)
features.line: Rated at 44 dB(A). Start it after dinner and let the evening carry on.

features.name: Height-adjustable upper basket
features.line: The upper basket moves up or down, making room for tall glasses above or large pots below.

features.name: ComfortClose
features.line: The door opens and closes with little effort and stays where you leave it.

features.name: Delay start
features.line: Set it to begin up to 24 hours later, to run overnight or while you are out.

also: A cutlery tray on top, Comfort baskets below
Can be connected to hot water
Clean Touch Steel front, fingerprint resistant, with a pocket handle
specs: Clean Touch Steel, fingerprint resistant, pocket handle
